MorganaR.name: Soul Shackles
MorganaR.tooltip:
Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing them by @SlowPercent@%. After @ChainDuration@ seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage and are Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

While casting this Ability, Morgana gains @HastePercent@% Move Speed.
Morgana gains True Sight of all enemies affected by this Ability.

MorganaW.name: Tormented Shadow
MorganaW.tooltip:
Morgana ignites the ground for @WDuration@ seconds, dealing @TotalMinDamage@ magic damage per second, increased by up to @TotalMaxDamage@ based on the targets' missing Health.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by @CDRefundPercent*100@% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon.
This Ability deals @MonsterMod@% damage to jungle monsters.

MorganaPassive.name: Soul Siphon
MorganaPassive.tooltip: Morgana <healing>Heals for @HealPercent@%</healing> of the damage dealt by her Abilities to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungle monsters.

MorganaE.name: Black Shield
MorganaE.tooltip: Morgana grants an ally champion <shield>@TotalShieldStrength@ Magic Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. The shield prevents <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects until it breaks.
